030        public static float OFFICER_MULT = 1.5f;
031        public static boolean isOfficer(MutableShipStatsAPI stats) {
032                if (stats.getEntity() instanceof ShipAPI) {
033                        ShipAPI ship = (ShipAPI) stats.getEntity();
034                        if (ship == null) return false;
035                        if (ship.isFighter() && ship.getWing() != null && ship.getWing().getSourceShip() != null) {
036                                ship = ship.getWing().getSourceShip();
037                        }
038                        if (ship == null) return false;
039                        return ship.getCaptain() != null && !ship.getCaptain().isDefault();
040                } else {
041                        FleetMemberAPI member = stats.getFleetMember();
042                        if (member == null) return false;
043                        return !member.getCaptain().isDefault();
044                }
045        }
046        
047        public static class Level1 extends BaseSkillEffectDescription implements ShipSkillEffect {
048                
049                public void apply(MutableShipStatsAPI stats, HullSize hullSize, String id, float level) {
050                        float crewLossReduction = computeAndCacheThresholdBonus(stats, "fu_crew_loss", CREW_LOSS_PERCENT, ThresholdBonusType.FIGHTER_BAYS);
051                        if (isOfficer(stats)) crewLossReduction *= OFFICER_MULT;
052                        stats.getDynamic().getStat(Stats.FIGHTER_CREW_LOSS_MULT).modifyMult(id, 1f - crewLossReduction / 100f);
053                }
054                
055                public void unapply(MutableShipStatsAPI stats, HullSize hullSize, String id) {
056                        stats.getDynamic().getStat(Stats.FIGHTER_CREW_LOSS_MULT).unmodifyMult(id);
057                }
058                
059                public String getEffectDescription(float level) {
060                        return null;
061                }
062                
063                public void createCustomDescription(MutableCharacterStatsAPI stats, SkillSpecAPI skill, 
064                                                                                        TooltipMakerAPI info, float width) {
065                        init(stats, skill);
066
067
068                        FleetDataAPI data = getFleetData(null);
069                        float crewLossReduction = computeAndCacheThresholdBonus(data, stats, "fu_crew_loss", CREW_LOSS_PERCENT, ThresholdBonusType.FIGHTER_BAYS);
070
071                        info.addPara("-%s crew lost due to fighter losses in combat (maximum: %s)", 0f, hc, hc,
072                                        "" + (int) crewLossReduction + "%",
073                                        "" + (int) CREW_LOSS_PERCENT + "%");
074                        //info.addSpacer(5f);
075                }
076                
077                public ScopeDescription getScopeDescription() {
078                        return ScopeDescription.ALL_SHIPS;
079                }
080
081        }

084        public static class Level2 extends BaseSkillEffectDescription implements ShipSkillEffect, FleetTotalSource {
085                
086                public FleetTotalItem getFleetTotalItem() {
087                        return getFighterBaysTotal();
088                }
089                
090                public void apply(MutableShipStatsAPI stats, HullSize hullSize, String id, float level) {
091//                      float damBonus = getDamageBonus(stats);
092//                      stats.getBallisticWeaponDamageMult().modifyPercent(id, damBonus);
093//                      stats.getEnergyWeaponDamageMult().modifyPercent(id, damBonus);
094//                      stats.getMissileWeaponDamageMult().modifyPercent(id, damBonus);
095                        
096                        float speedBonus = getMaxSpeedBonus(stats);
097                        if (isOfficer(stats)) speedBonus *= OFFICER_MULT;
098                        stats.getMaxSpeed().modifyPercent(id, speedBonus);
099                        stats.getAcceleration().modifyPercent(id, speedBonus * 2f);
100                        stats.getDeceleration().modifyPercent(id, speedBonus * 2f);
101                        
102                        float aimBonus = getAimBonus(stats);
103                        if (isOfficer(stats)) aimBonus *= OFFICER_MULT;
104                        stats.getAutofireAimAccuracy().modifyFlat(id, aimBonus * 0.01f);
105                        
106                        float hpBonus = getMissileHPBonus(stats);
107                        if (isOfficer(stats)) hpBonus *= OFFICER_MULT;
108                        stats.getMissileHealthBonus().modifyPercent(id, hpBonus);
109                        
110                        float damBonus = getDamageBonus(stats);
111                        if (isOfficer(stats)) damBonus *= OFFICER_MULT;
112                        stats.getBallisticWeaponDamageMult().modifyPercent(id, damBonus);
113                        stats.getEnergyWeaponDamageMult().modifyPercent(id, damBonus);
114                        stats.getMissileWeaponDamageMult().modifyPercent(id, damBonus);
115                }
116

118//                      stats.getBallisticWeaponDamageMult().unmodifyPercent(id);
119//                      stats.getEnergyWeaponDamageMult().unmodifyPercent(id);
120//                      stats.getMissileWeaponDamageMult().unmodifyPercent(id);
121                        
122                        stats.getMaxSpeed().unmodifyPercent(id);
123                        stats.getAcceleration().unmodifyPercent(id);
124                        stats.getDeceleration().unmodifyPercent(id);
125                        
126                        stats.getAutofireAimAccuracy().unmodifyFlat(id);
127                        
128                        stats.getMissileHealthBonus().unmodifyPercent(id);
129                        
130                        stats.getBallisticWeaponDamageMult().unmodifyPercent(id);
131                        stats.getEnergyWeaponDamageMult().unmodifyPercent(id);
132                        stats.getMissileWeaponDamageMult().unmodifyPercent(id);
133                }

155                protected float getMaxSpeedBonus(MutableShipStatsAPI stats) {
156                        FleetDataAPI data = getFleetData(stats);
157                        return getMaxSpeedBonus(data);
158                }
159                
160                protected float getMaxSpeedBonus(FleetDataAPI data) {
161                        if (data == null) return MAX_SPEED_PERCENT;
162                        String key = "fighter_uplink_max_speed";
163                        Float bonus = (Float) data.getCacheClearedOnSync().get(key);
164                        if (bonus != null) return bonus;
165                        
166                        float bays = getNumFighterBays(data);
167                        bonus = getThresholdBasedRoundedBonus(MAX_SPEED_PERCENT, bays, FIGHTER_BAYS_THRESHOLD);
168                        
169                        data.getCacheClearedOnSync().put(key, bonus);
170                        return bonus;
171                }
172                
173                protected float getAimBonus(MutableShipStatsAPI stats) {
174                        FleetDataAPI data = getFleetData(stats);
175                        return getAimBonus(data);
176                }
177                
178                protected float getAimBonus(FleetDataAPI data) {
179                        if (data == null) return TARGET_LEADING_BONUS;
180                        String key = "fighter_uplink_aim";
181                        Float bonus = (Float) data.getCacheClearedOnSync().get(key);
182                        if (bonus != null) return bonus;
183                        
184                        float bays = getNumFighterBays(data);
185                        bonus = getThresholdBasedRoundedBonus(TARGET_LEADING_BONUS, bays, FIGHTER_BAYS_THRESHOLD);
186                        
187                        data.getCacheClearedOnSync().put(key, bonus);
188                        return bonus;
189                }

196                protected float getMissileHPBonus(FleetDataAPI data) {
197                        if (data == null) return MISSILE_HP_BONUS;
198                        String key = "fighter_uplink_hp";
199                        Float bonus = (Float) data.getCacheClearedOnSync().get(key);
200                        if (bonus != null) return bonus;
201                        
202                        float bays = getNumFighterBays(data);
203                        bonus = getThresholdBasedRoundedBonus(MISSILE_HP_BONUS, bays, FIGHTER_BAYS_THRESHOLD);
204                        
205                        data.getCacheClearedOnSync().put(key, bonus);
206                        return bonus;
207                }

214                protected float getDamageBonus(FleetDataAPI data) {
215                        if (data == null) return DAMAGE_BONUS_PERCENT;
216                        String key = "fighter_uplink_damage";
217                        Float bonus = (Float) data.getCacheClearedOnSync().get(key);
218                        if (bonus != null) return bonus;
219                        
220                        float bays = getNumFighterBays(data);
221                        bonus = getThresholdBasedRoundedBonus(DAMAGE_BONUS_PERCENT, bays, FIGHTER_BAYS_THRESHOLD);
222                        
223                        data.getCacheClearedOnSync().put(key, bonus);
224                        return bonus;
225                }
